reasons: The plan gets the existing API right: POST /configs upsert (server.mjs:33-37, lib/store.mjs line 30) ignores null/blank, and DELETE /configs/:key removes the whole row (lib/store.mjs remove, line 40).
It weighs the prescribed PUT against reusing the upsert and drops the PUT, because POST {key, credential} already replaces the credential and an existing test already covers it.

It gives a concrete reason for the credential-only DELETE: nothing today can clear only the credential, and the full delete would lose the row. It also rejects letting the upsert accept null, since that would break the 'blank never wipes' behaviour.
It says outright which brief instruction it does not follow (PUT /configs/:key/credential) and why, in both the decision table and a 'Not followed' line.
